tips.text: Run Circulus, not Yuvarium, even on normal; it pays more Plasm and better part odds.
Run it in a full squad; more Thrax spawn each rotation, so more Plasm drops.
Run it while the node is the Omnia fissure to stack in-mission bonuses and crack relics in the same 20 minutes.
Buy any blueprint that has not dropped from Yonta with banked Plasm instead of chasing Rotation C.
Regroup before each 5-minute mark so the Thrax spawn together; Plasm pickups despawn after 60 seconds.
Finish Angels of the Zariman before farming blueprints; without its Voidgel Orbs you cannot build anything.
Bring your Operator; only its Void Beam finishes the Eclipse Thrax, and they drain life support while alive.
Expect many misses; Sarofang and Perigale parts share Rotation C and drop more often.
Skip a Thrax stuck kneeling and undamageable; it drops no Plasm.
Insert Security Bypasses near the life-support towers to speed the mission clock; Orokin Eye or Golden Instinct finds them.
Bring a frame that kills Thrax fast, such as Kullervo, or Octavia if Steel Path Circulus is too much.
Budget three to four hours of Rotation C runs; players call it boring, not hard.
